Class AnahataStatusBarWidget

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.ui.status.AnahataStatusBarWidget
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.openapi.Disposable, com.intellij.openapi.wm.StatusBarWidget, com.intellij.openapi.wm.StatusBarWidget.TextPresentation, com.intellij.openapi.wm.StatusBarWidget.WidgetPresentation
public class AnahataStatusBarWidget extends Object implements com.intellij.openapi.wm.StatusBarWidget, com.intellij.openapi.wm.StatusBarWidget.TextPresentation
Status-bar widget showing the number of active Anahata sessions, with a click that focuses the Anahata tool window.

The count is refreshed on a short recurring Swing-thread timer via Alarm. Session data is read through AgiContext (the live container/session registry).

Author:
anahata
